name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Account Management & Client Success | SMB SaaS Retention, Adoption & Expansion | Salesforce
summary: Account manager and client success professional with 15+ years working with small-business clients on SaaS platforms. Retained all but one of 15-20 reseller partners at Birdeye (~94%), onboarded 25+ clients a month at Wix at 120% of sales targets, and has closed deals by phone at up to 10 a month. Builds relationships by phone and email, drives fuller platform adoption, and spots where an existing client is ready for more. Hands-on in Salesforce, HubSpot, and GoHighLevel, with the technical depth to explain apps, analytics, and integrations in plain language.

experience.title: Client Success & Account Management (Founder & Strategic / Marketing Operations Lead)
bullets: Own the primary relationship for a portfolio of small service businesses, running discovery and onboarding to surface their goals and drive results on complex SaaS platforms.
Identify expansion opportunities in existing accounts, recommending and scoping complementary services and writing proposals for expanded engagements.
Report performance on a regular cadence with GA4 and CRM data, turning results into clear recommendations for business owners.
Built an automated digital-footprint audit that profiled 180+ businesses online and triggered personalized outreach, converting 2 to paying clients.
Published 18 articles educating small-business owners on CRM setup, automation, attribution, and search visibility.

experience.title: Account Executive / Client Strategist
bullets: Managed ~3 client accounts at $20K+/month in ad spend each (peaking above $100K/month), delivering QBRs and optimization recommendations.
Resolved client feedback promptly and held delivery quality consistent to protect satisfaction and retention.

Advised partners on retention strategy, customer health metrics, and automated workflows so they could communicate product value to their own clients.
Analyzed partner utilization in Salesforce to find adoption gaps and recommend interventions that reduced churn.
Ran 50+ partner activities per day across phone and email, and shared structured client feedback with Product and Engineering to inform the roadmap.
